headline: Recessed public hearings on five special permits, plus a 181-185 Felton Street zoning amendment.
summary: A zoning amendment for 181-185 Felton Street would get its first reading. Funding items include $462,755 for Police Station Fire Administration Wing design, $64,600 for the Lake Street Fire Station roof, and $42,536 for the Farwell Street Bridge.
